description: The full SAM.gov registration of one entity by UEI or CAGE: names, status, dates, address city and state, NAICS, PSC, business types, SBA certifications. Costs credits like the REST call. Every answer has meta.as_of (the dataset date) and a record_url to the SAM.gov or USAspending source.

cage.description: 5-character CAGE code, if there is no UEI.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: get_entity
